about_the_game: Frame of Mind is a cozy narrative sim about growing up as an unusual kid. Discover the main character by going trough mementos and memories they have in their youth room. You can try to make sense of how they are thinking about themselves, but they may not have the best sense of self. Play the full game to help them find a better frame of mind.

content_descriptors.notes: This game includes the main character remembering and thinking about encounters with nudity and sexuality they had growing up. We, the developers, think it is appropriate for ages 12 and up. All parents and children that played the game so far have agreed with that.
